# Pune Global Group

> Pune Global Group is an industrial packaging manufacturer in Pune, India, producing precision PP trays, boxes, separators, crates and bins for automotive, pharma and electronics, plus converting and trading FBB paper & board grades across 21 Indian states. Est. 1995.

## Key facts
- Type: B2B industrial packaging manufacturer & paper/board trader
- Audience: automotive OEMs, pharma manufacturers, electronics makers, FMCG and packaging buyers across India
- Founded: 1995, Pune, Maharashtra
- Facilities: Sanaswadi MIDC plant + Gulmohar Centre Point office, Pune
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, FSC, BRC
- Product categories: PP corrugated packaging and Paper & Board
- Serves: 21 states, 50+ active clients, 1M+ ton material supplied
- Status: Live production facility, export-ready
